text:
dana: Heads-up: got a weird edge in canary vs baseline on the 'code-example' slice. v4-int8 has higher BLEU-ish score but produces truncated completions sometimes at seqlen ~1024. Need to gate on truncation rate.

omar: That's concerning. Add truncation_rate slice check with threshold 0.5% and abort if exceeded. Also require model to maintain token-level entropy within +/-5% of baseline for that slice.

sylvie: Can we make the gate compute both absolute and relative deltas? In some small slices absolute delta matters more than percent. For truncation maybe absolute > 0.2% OR relative > 25% triggers.

dana: Good catch. I'll add to the promote policy. Also note: deploy artifact: https://ci.internal/reports/1742301110-code-sanity.html (truncation_v4=0.9%, truncation_base=0.2%).

ci-bot: Replay job queued: replay-174230-truncation-check (20k samples).

dana: After replay, if truncation persists, we should blacklist v4-int8 for longdoc/coareval slices and re-evaluate with kv-prefill.

omar: Also log `truncate_examples` with example ids in the canary report for triage.

sylvie: Great. Let's fold these into the promote-policy proto so rollout-service enforces truncation checks automatically.
